title: I AM DONE WAITING — GOD OF ELIJAH ARISE AND SEND RAIN TO MY DRY SEASON
text: Somebody lift your hands where you are. Don't lift it like a formality. Lift it like a man drowning lifts his hand out of the water like this is the last gesture you have before you go under. Lift it like that because there is something about tonight that is not going to be business as usual. I felt it the moment I walked into this atmosphere. There is a groaning in the spirit. There is a travailing. Something in heaven is waiting for a company of people who are done being polite with their delay. Somebody say it out loud, I am done waiting. Say it again like you mean it in your belly, not just your mouth. I am done waiting. There is a difference between a person who is patient and a person who has been managed into silence by disappointment. Patience is a fruit of the spirit. But there is a counterfeit patience, a false calm that is not faith at all. It is fatigue wearing faith's clothes. And I perceive that many of you did not come here patient tonight. You came here tired. You came here having smiled in public and wept in private. You came here having testified for other people while your own chapter refuses to turn. Tonight the spirit of the Lord says that chapter turns. I want you to hold the atmosphere with me. Don't let it drop. Something is being birthed. Let's go into the throne room together not with noise first but with honesty first. Lord, we are not going to perform for you tonight. We are going to be honest before you. There are dry places in this house. There are marriages in this house holding on by threads thinner than they've ever admitted. There [music] are business owners in this house who smile on Sunday and calculate losses on Monday. There are students in this house who have written the same exam of life over and over believing next time will be different and next time keeps looking like last time. Father, we are not ashamed to tell you the truth tonight. We are dry. Send rain. Somebody begin to hum right now. Not a song with words yet. Just a hum, just a sound from the belly because something wants to rise before the words come. Hmm, Lord. Hmm. Now, let the tongues rise. Let the language of the spirit take over where English cannot reach. Raba shilama kadesh torova shilama kadesh baraka shalomai. I feel a witness in my spirit that heaven has been listening to this room longer than we've been aware. There is an old prayer some of you prayed 2 years ago, 3 years ago that God did not forget. Tonight is the delivery room for prayers you thought had miscarried. Number number, let me take you to a mountain. I want to take you somewhere in the scriptures. Turn with me in your heart if not in your hands to 1 Kings chapter 18. There is a prophet standing on a mountain called Carmel. Israel has been in drought not for one season, not for two seasons, but for 3 and 1/2 years. No rain, no dew. The brooks have gone silent. The ground has cracked like the face of an old man who has cried too many nights. But here is what I want you to see. In 1 Kings 18 verse 41, after Elijah has just finished dealing with the false prophets, after the fire has fallen and consumed the sacrifice, the wood, the stones, and even the water in the trench, Elijah turns to King Ahab and says something strange. He says, "Get thee up eat and drink for there is a sound of abundance of rain." Now, here is the revelation and it is going to unlock something in you tonight. >> [music] >> When Elijah said this, there was not a single cloud in the sky, not one. The text tells us in verse 44 that his servant went and looked toward the sea seven times before he came back and said, "Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea like a man's hand." Seven times, not once, not twice. Seven times the servant went and six times he came back with nothing to report but sky, blue, and dry, and mocking. But Elijah did not shift his position because the sky did not shift its appearance. He had heard something in the spirit realm before it showed up in the natural realm. He heard the sound of abundance of rain when there was no visual evidence of a single drop. Church, I need you to understand something about your situation tonight. Your breakthrough is not going to announce itself first in the visible. It is going to announce itself first as a sound in your spirit and you are going to have to have the audacity of Elijah to declare it before your eyes. Agree with your mouth. Somebody shout it. I hear the sound of abundance of rain. Louder, I hear the sound of abundance of rain. There is a woman here tonight whose womb has been like the sky over Israel, clear, unclouded, seemingly settled. I speak to that womb in the name of Jesus. Begin to hear the sound of abundance of rain. There is a man here whose business account has been reading zero for longer than he has told anyone. I speak to that account tonight. Hear the sound of abundance of rain. There is a marriage here that has been existing on fumes. Two people sleeping the same bed like strangers assigned to the same room. I speak to that marriage, hear the sound of abundance of rain. Number number, the dry season is not your identity. I want to establish something doctrinally before I go further into fire because revelation must sit on a foundation, not float on emotion. Genesis 8:22 says, "While the earth remained, seedtime [music] and harvest and cold and heat and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease. God himself established that seasons change. He did not establish permanent winter. He did not establish eternal drought. Every season carries within it the built-in mechanism of its own ending. A dry season, by covenant definition, is temporary. If it is not ending, it is not because God changed his mind about seasons. It is because something is holding the season in place that must be forcibly removed. This is important because some of you have started to believe that dryness is simply who you are. You've said it with your mouth, "I'm just not the lucky type. Maybe this is my portion. Some people are just meant to struggle." Church, that is not humility. That is agreement with a lie. Genesis 8:22 did not say some people get exempted from the harvest side of the equation. It said seed time and harvest. If you have sown, and many of you have sown in tears, sown in tights, sown in service, sown in faithfulness, while nobody was watching, then somewhere written into the fabric of this universe, a harvest owes you an appearance. I decree over somebody tonight, your harvest is not lost. It is only overdue. And overdue is not the same as canceled. Turn with me to James chapter 5 verses 17 and 18. The scripture says, "Elijah was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it rained not on the earth by the space of 3 years and 6 months. And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit." Did you see that? A man subject to like passions as we are. Elijah was not a special species of human. He was not an angel wearing a disguise. He was a man with weaknesses, with fears. The same Elijah who called down fire on Carmel ran from a woman named Jezebel one chapter later and asked God to kill him under a juniper tree. That is the same man. The man who shut heaven and opened heaven by prayer is the same man who in his lowest moment wanted to die. I say this to somebody tonight, your weakness does not disqualify you from being the one who shuts the drought and opens the rain. God is not looking for flawless people. He's looking for praying people. And you with all your cracks, with all your Jezebel fears, with all your juniper tree moments, you qualify to pray this rain down tonight. Say it with your chest. If Elijah could do it with my weaknesses, then I can do it with my faith. Number number, the fire before the rain. Notice the order in 1 Kings 18. The fire fell first before the rain came. The fire had to fall and consume the wrong altar. There was an altar of Baal that had been receiving attention, receiving sacrifice, receiving the devotion that belonged to the living God. Before heaven released rain, heaven released fire to deal with the false altar. I want to prophesy to you that some of your dry seasons are not simply waiting periods. Some of them are directly connected to an altar that has not yet been dealt with. Maybe it's an altar of bitterness you've been secretly tending. Maybe it's an altar of unforgiveness where you keep sacrificing your peace every time you replay what they did to you. Maybe it's an ancestral altar, something from your bloodline, an agreement your forefathers made that has been quietly diverting the rain meant for your life toward another cause. Tonight, before we ask for rain, let the fire fall first. Father, in the name of Jesus, wherever there is an altar competing for what belongs to you in my life, let fire fall now and consume it completely. Let every hidden altar in the village, in the family house, in the place of my birth, on the head of my history, be exposed and BURNED BY THE FIRE OF THE LIVING GOD. Somebody begin to pray fire prayers right now. Don't wait for me. Pray it in your own language. Pray it in tongues. Pray it in groans if you have no words. Fire of God fall now. Fire of God consume now. Every altar that has kept my heavens closed be consumed by fire in Jesus' name. Katoshi bara elai shabakaratoshi. Fire consuming utterance rising bakashilamara. I sense something breaking in the spirit realm even as we pray. There is a sound of iron gates cracking. There is a sound somewhere between the physical and the spiritual. The sound of something old finally letting go of its grip. >> [music] >> Number number, when the cloud is the size of a hand. Let's go back to that servant going up and down the mountain seven times. I want you to notice something about verse 44. When the cloud finally appeared, it was described as like a man's hand, not like a blanket covering the sky. Not like an ocean so suspended above them. Like a man's hand, small, almost easy to dismiss, almost easy to explain away as nothing. But Elijah did not despise it. He did not say that's too small, come back when it's bigger. He recognized that the size of the first sign is never the size of the coming move. He told Ahab, "Immediately prepare your chariot. Get down before the rain stops you." >> [music] >> He acted on a hand-sized cloud as though it was already a flood. This is a word for somebody tonight. Stop despising the small signs. That interview that almost didn't happen, but happened, that's a hand-sized cloud. That unexpected small alert on your account, hand-sized cloud. That person who reached out to reconnect after years of silence, hand-sized cloud. That test result that came back slightly better than the last one, hand-sized cloud. Don't you dare mock what God is starting small because Zechariah 4:10 asks the question directly. For who had despised the day of small things? Don't be found among those who despised it. I prophesy over somebody's hand-sized cloud right now. Grow, expand, cover the whole sky of that situation in the name of Jesus. Number number preaching flow, the God who answers by fire and by water. Church, I need you to understand the character of the God we serve. He's not a one-dimensional deity who only knows how to do one kind of miracle. The same God who answered Elijah by fire on Mount Carmel is the same God who answered him by rain 17 verses later. He's not limited to your expectation of him. Some of you have boxed God into he only answers this way for me, but Malachi 3:6 declares, "For I am the Lord, I change not." He does not change, but his methods with you can shift from fire to rain in the same chapter of your life because he's not predictable in method, only faithful in character. I want to remind you of Isaiah 55:10 and 11. For as the rain cometh down and the snow from heaven and returneth not either, but watereth the earth and maketh it bring forth and board that it may give seed to the sower and bread to the eater, so shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth. It shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing where to I sent it. Do you see the pattern God is teaching us? Rain does not go back to the sky empty-handed. It falls, it does its work in the soil, and only then does its purpose complete. God is saying, "My word behaves exactly like rain. When I send it into your situation, it is not returning to me until it has made something grow, until it has made something bored, until it has produced seed for the sower and bread for the eater." This means the word I am releasing tonight is not decoration. It is not entertainment for your Friday evening. It is rain word, and rain word does not return void. I speak the rain word over your finances tonight. Go, do your work, and do not return until there is increase. I speak the rain word over your body tonight. Go, do your work of healing, and do not return until there is restoration. I speak the rain word over your marriage tonight. Go, do your work of reconciliation, and do not return until there is oneness restored. Somebody give God a shout in this place because his word does not go back empty. Number Number on the subject of delay. Let me address delay directly because I know some of you have theological confusion about it. You've heard people say delay is not denial so many times it has become a cliché that no longer comforts you. I want to give you something deeper than a cliché tonight. In John chapter 11, when Lazarus was sick, the sister sent word to Jesus. Verse 6 says something that troubles many readers. When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was. Jesus got the message and stayed two more days. He did not rush and by the time he arrived, Lazarus had been in the grave four days. But here is the revelation, Jesus was not late. He was walking on a resurrection timeline, not a healing timeline. If he had come immediately, Lazarus would have merely been healed of sickness. Because he tarried, Lazarus became a resurrection testimony instead of a healing testimony. I need somebody to receive this. Your delay is not because God forgot you. Your delay might be because God is not doing a small miracle in your case. He is preparing you for something so much bigger than what you originally asked for that the timeline had to stretch to accommodate the size of what's coming. Say this out loud, "My delay is not denial. My delay is divine positioning for something greater than what I asked." Turn to Habakkuk chapter 2 verse 3 with me. For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak and not lie. Though it tarry, wait for it because it will surely come. It will not tarry. Notice the tension in that verse itself. It tarries and yet it will not tarry. Both statements are true simultaneously. From your vantage point, it tarries. From heaven's appointed calendar, it will not be one day late. The vision is not lost in transit. [music] It has an appointed time and appointed things always arrive. Number number, a word of knowledge. I need to stop and say something specific because the spirit of the Lord is highlighting someone right now. There is a person here or watching this who has been dealing with a report from a hospital that they have not told their full family about. You have been [music] carrying it alone, praying about it alone, researching about it late at night alone. God says tonight, you will not carry this alone anymore because I am about to change the report. Before the next appointment there will be a difference that even the doctor cannot explain medically. There is someone else a business decision you have been sitting on for almost a year. You keep going back and forth. God says the hesitation you felt is not weakness. It was divine restraint because the version of the deal you were about to take was not the full version of what I have for you. Something better is coming in its place within a short window. There is a young man here whose mother has been praying for him specifically about a direction he almost took. God says tell your mother her prayers registered in heaven. The door you almost walked through has been closed by mercy not by mistake. If any of these words touch you, don't just nod internally. Respond to God right now wherever you are. Number number prayer flow destiny restoration. Let's go deeper into prayer. Put your hand on your chest. Feel your own heartbeat. That heartbeat is evidence that your story is not finished because dead men don't need to pray for destiny. Only living men do and you are alive which means your chapter is still being written. Jeremiah 29:11 says for I know the thoughts that I think toward you said the Lord thoughts of peace and not of evil to give you an expected end. Notice he said thoughts plural not one single generic plan for all humanity. He has a specific thought concerning you a specific expected end assigned to your name. Pray with me now. Say Father in the name of Jesus every thought you have concerning me let it locate me now. >> [clears throat] >> Every plan of the enemy to divert my destiny into someone else's story be cancelled in Jesus name. Anywhere my star has been buried dig it up by fire. In Jesus mighty name. Every destiny swap, every switching of portions that happened in the spirit realm without my knowledge or consent be reversed tonight. I decree I will not die carrying another man's version of my life. I will fulfill the original blueprint written concerning me before the foundation of the world. Ephesians 2:10 tells us we are created in Christ Jesus onto good works which God had before ordained that we should walk in them. Before ordained, not improvised, not a backup plan. There was an original document with your name and your good works already written before you were born. Pray this, Father, restore to me the original document of my life. Let every page the enemy tore out be supernaturally restored. Number number prayer flow family deliverance. Now, let's move into something heavier. Some of you did not come here only for yourself. You came here carrying your family on your shoulders like Simon carrying the cross for Jesus. Somebody in your house needs deliverance and you've been the intercessor standing in the gap. Joshua 24:15 gives us the declaration, but as for me and my house we will serve the Lord. That is not just a personal statement, that is a household covenant. When Joshua spoke, he was speaking authority over every soul under his roof. Pray with me. Father, in the name of Jesus, I stand as priest over my household tonight. Every prodigal child, every wandering son, every wandering daughter, I call them back by the spirit of the living God. Every strong man assigned to distract, delay, or destroy any member of my family be bound and cast out now. Every generational pattern, addiction, divorce, sickness, poverty, madness, premature death that has cycled through my bloodline stop here. It stops with me. It does not pass to my children. I speak peace over every troubled home connected to my bloodline. I speak reconciliation where there has been silence for years. Somebody's phone is about to ring this week from a family member who has not spoken to them in a long time. I prophesy that call in the name of Jesus. Number number prophetic declaration. Hold on before we move further. I sense something rising. Stand to your feet if you can. By the authority of the word of God, I declare over this gathering you are not a generational statistic. You are a generational solution. I declare the same drought that swallowed those before you will not swallow you because you carry the Elijah anointing to shut it down and open it up. I declare every door that closed prematurely in your life is being unlocked by a master key tonight in Jesus mighty name. I declare this is your set time of favor spoken of in Psalm 102:13. Thou shall arise and have mercy upon Zion for the time to favor her. Yea, the set time is come. Somebody scream it, my set time has come. Number number prayer flow marriage breakthrough. Let's minister to marriages now and to those believing for marriage. For those already married, some of you are exhausted. You are managing a marriage, not enjoying one. You've reduced your expectations to simply at least we are not fighting today. God did not design marriage for mere survival. He designed it according to Genesis 2:24 for two to become one flesh, one unit, one force, not two competing individuals cohabiting. Pray with me. Father, restore the one flesh reality in my marriage. Where we have become two strangers under one roof, make us one again. Every third party physical, spiritual, financial, emotional interfering in my marriage be exposed and removed in Jesus' name. Every spirit of strife assigned to my home, I [music] bind you and cast you out now in the name of Jesus. I speak romance back into marriages that have gone cold. I speak laughter back into homes that have gone silent. I speak intimacy back into unions that have grown distant. >> [clears throat] >> For those believing for marriage, I know some of you have watched younger ones from your circle get married while you remain waiting and the enemy has whispered that something is wrong with you. I break that lie now. Genesis 2:18 says, "And the Lord God said, it is not good that the man should be alone. I will make him an help meet for him." God himself initiated the idea of companionship. If he initiated it, he's not withholding it from you out of spite. Pray with me. Father, I release myself from every covenant of singleness that was not spoken by me but has attached itself to my life. I break every spirit husband and every spirit wife assigned to hinder my earthly marriage in the name of Jesus. I call forth my divine helper from the north, south, east and west. Let there be a supernatural convergence in Jesus' name. Barakatoshi Marai Shilomakabadesh Ratoshilai Bashalom number number prayer flow financial gates opening. Somebody's palms are sweating just hearing this section start because you know what you've been dealing with quietly. Deuteronomy 28:12 says, "The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand. And thou shall lend unto many nations, and thou shall not borrow." Notice again, rain and treasure are tied together in the same verse. Financial breakthrough is part of the rain we've been praying for tonight. Pray with me. Father, open your good treasure over my life now in Jesus' name. Every gate that has been shut against my finances, physical gates, spiritual gates, ancestral gates, BE BROKEN OPEN NOW. I command every blocked alert, every delayed payment, every frozen account, every stopped contract to be released in the name of Jesus. I break the spirit of the financial leech. Every unseen drain on my resources of my life and business now. I decree what the enemy has eaten in the years of the locust, according to Joel 2:25, is being restored to me double in Jesus' name. Somebody shout, "Restoration is my portion." I prophesy that before this season ends, testimonies of unexpected money, unexpected contracts, and unexpected doors will begin to flood this house. Someone reading or hearing this will receive an alert that surprises them within days. Receive it in Jesus' name. Number number, prayer, flow, health, and healing. Let's minister to bodies now. Somebody has been managing pain quietly, taking medication, and smiling through service like nothing is happening internally. Exodus 15:26 declares, "I am the Lord that healeth thee." Not I am the Lord who sometimes heals. Not I am the Lord who heals depending on your works. I am the Lord that healeth thee. It is who he is, not merely what he occasionally does. Pray with me. Father, in the name of Jesus, every sickness that has refused to answer to medication, [music] answer now to the name of Jesus. Every hidden growth, every silent infection, every diagnosis waiting to be discovered be exposed and be dissolved by fire in Jesus' name. I speak to every organ malfunctioning quietly in someone's body right now, function correctly in Jesus' name. I speak to every chronic condition that has become a permanent tenant in someone's body. Your lease is terminated tonight in Jesus' mighty name. By the stripes of Jesus, according to Isaiah 53:5, with his stripes we are healed, I decree total healing over everybody in this place and beyond it. Somebody's next test result is going to leave the doctor confused. I prophesy it now, you will testify soon. Number Number Breaking covenants, curses, and evil altars. We touched fire on the altar earlier, but I want us to go one layer deeper now because some bondages are covenantal, meaning someone in your lineage or even you yourself in ignorance entered an agreement that has been quietly governing your life. Galatians 3:13 tells us, "Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us." This means every legal ground the enemy thinks he has because of an old covenant has already been answered at Calvary. Tonight, we are simply enforcing what Jesus already purchased. Pray with me with fire. Every evil covenant spoken over my life before I was born, I renounce you now in the name of Jesus. Every blood covenant made on my behalf without my consent be broken by the blood of Jesus. Every altar in my father's house, my mother's house, my ancestral village working against MY PROGRESS, RECEIVE FIRE NOW. I FIRE BACK every arrow of witchcraft sent against my destiny, my health, my finances, and my family in the name of Jesus. Every witch and wizard holding a meeting concerning my life, scatter now by fire. Any coven assigned to monitor my progress and report it for sabotage, be exposed, be scattered, and be judged in Jesus' mighty name. Kadesh rabatoshima, shilo fire consuming raw, bakadesh toshilai. I feel something shifting. There is resistance breaking in the spirit realm right now. Some of you feel a physical lightness on your chest as we speak. That is not imagination. That is deliverance in real time. Number number prophetic declaration. I decree every yoke assigned to keep you bent over is snapping right now. In the name of Jesus, I decree you will stand up straight in every area you have been bowed down physically, financially, emotionally, and spiritually. I decree, according to Luke chapter 13, that the spirit of infirmity that bowed a woman for 18 years and could not straighten herself has no legal right over you anymore. Jesus is saying to you what he said to her, "Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity." Somebody say it, "I am loosed." Number number prayer flow angelic intervention. Hebrews 1:14 asks, "Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?" You have angels assigned to your case file. Some of you have simply never activated them through prayer. Pray with me, "Father, dispatch angels on assignment concerning my situation right now in the name of Jesus. Let angels go ahead of me into every meeting, every interview, every negotiation, and prepare the room before I arrive. Let angels of restoration go and recover everything the enemy has stolen from my life over the years. Let angels of protection stand at every gate of my life, over my health, over my family, over my finances, over my travels. I decree, according to Psalm 91:11, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways." I am kept in all my ways, not just some of my ways. Number number prayer flow time and virtue restoration. There is something I must address that many ministers skip the restoration of time and virtue. Some of you have given away years to the wrong relationships, the wrong jobs, the wrong cities, the wrong decisions. You feel like a person who started a race late and can never catch up. Joel 2:25 again, "I will restore to you the years that the locust have eaten." Notice it is years, plural, not moments. God is not merely giving you today back. He's capable of compressing what should have taken years into a shorter season. Because with him, time is a servant not a master. Pray with me. Father, restore to me the years the enemy has stolen through delay, destruction, and deception in Jesus' name. Compress in months what ordinarily would take years in my life in Jesus' mighty name. Restore my virtue, every strength drained from me through wrong relationships, wrong soul ties, wrong exposures be restored now. Every strength I lost through unnecessary battles, unnecessary grief, unnecessary striving, Father, restore it to me now. I decree I am not behind schedule. My schedule has been recalculated by heaven and I will arrive exactly on time. Number number prayer, flow divine preservation. As we begin to draw toward the peak of this ministration, let's cover ourselves in preservation because breakthrough without preservation is temporary, but breakthrough with preservation is generational. Psalm 121:7-8 says, "The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil. He shall preserve thy soul. The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth and even forevermore." Pray with me, Father, preserve everything you're about to release into my hands tonight. Let no one steal my testimony before it fully manifests. Let no accident, no premature death, no sudden setback touch what you are releasing to me now. Preserve my marriage, preserve my children, preserve my health, preserve my finances, preserve my sanity, preserve my joy in the name of Jesus. I decree what God gives me tonight, no man, no demon, no circumstance will be able to take from me. Number number the peak, prophetic utterances. I sense the atmosphere has reached a peak. Let the words fall as they come. Rain is falling on situations that look permanently dry. Somebody's ceiling just became somebody's floor. There is a document being signed in an office tonight that will change someone's next 5 years. I see a delayed visa suddenly approved. I see a womb that doctors called impossible receiving a different verdict. I see a marriage certificate being issued before the year ends for someone who almost gave up on love. I see a business that nearly closed down instead opening a second branch. There is a phone call coming not today, not tomorrow, but soon that will answer 3 years of silence. I hear the sound of chains falling off a family member you've been praying for in secret. I see someone walking without the support they've needed for years. I see a testimony microphone in someone's hand before the year runs out. Somebody's obituary that the enemy had already written in the spirit realm is being torn up right now. fire falling now. Number number final charge and closing prayer. I want to bring this ministration to its landing but not without leaving something structural in you, not just emotional. Church, rain does not fall on hardened ground the same way it falls on tilled ground. If the ground is hard, the same rain that should nourish will simply run off and cause erosion instead of growth. This means tonight is not only about God sending rain. It is also about you allowing your heart to be broken up before him. So, the rain does something in you instead of just around you. Hosea 10:12 says, "Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy, break up your fallow ground, for it is time to seek the Lord till he come and rain righteousness upon you." Break up your fallow ground. Let go of the bitterness. Let go of the comparison. Let go of the private resentment toward God that some of you have been nursing quietly wondering why others seem to move faster. Surrender that now, so the rain that falls tonight produces fruit instead of flooding. Pray this with me as our final declaration. Father, I break up my own fallow ground tonight. I remove every hardness from my heart. I receive your rain not just around me, but into me. I receive the rain of the Holy Spirit afresh. I receive the rain of divine strategy for the next phase of my life. I receive the rain of restored joy, restored hope, restored expectation. God of Elijah, the same God who answered by fire and answered by rain, I decree that you arise on my behalf right now. Let every dry season assigned to my life, my family, my marriage, my finances, and my health receive its expiration date tonight. I am done waiting on my own strength. I am done managing disappointment. I am done calling delay my identity. Tonight, I stand like Elijah on the mountain, and I declare over my own life, I hear the sound of abundance of rain. Somebody give him one final shout of praise. Not because the results have shown up in the natural yet, but because you heard the sound before you saw the cloud. That is what faith has always been. Go in peace. Go in expectation. Go watching the sky of your life, because the rain is already on its way.
